evals.description: Developer asks whether to validate the entity after making changes.
evals.prompt: I just added a new AC to US-042. Should I run any validation before committing?
evals.expected_output: Yes — run scripts/validate_entity.py against the updated entity file. This checks required fields, ID format (US-<nnn>-AC-<n> pattern), status values, and AC structure. If it exits 1, fix the reported errors before committing.

Notes --catalog flag for referential integrity checks

evals.description: Developer asks how to handle promoting a User Story that fails an invariant check.
evals.prompt: I want to set US-089 status to 'active', but it only has one AC and it's a happy-path AC. Is that OK?
evals.expected_output: No. US-089 cannot be promoted to 'active' because it is missing at least one error or alternative-path AC. The promotion invariant requires at least one error/alternative AC to prevent User Stories from shipping with untested failure paths. Add at least one AC for a failure scenario before promoting. Example: 'When the delivery address is outside the shipping zone, the order is rejected with a clear reason.'
expectations: Blocks promotion — invariant not met
Identifies the failing invariant: missing error/alternative-path AC
Proposes an example error-path AC
Does not set status to active until the invariant passes

OLD and NEW AC shown side by side before writing

evals.prompt: I need to rename FEAT-001 (Checkout Page). What are the cascade steps?
evals.expected_output: Feature rename cascade — 7 steps: (1) Update the Feature entity file: change 'name' field. (Note: numeric 'id' should not be changed after creation.) (2) Update all references in Functionality entities that link to this Feature. (3) Update feature_registry.json: replace the old name with the new name under the numeric key. (4) Update manifest.json / seed.yaml: update the Feature name entry. (5) Update PageObject file headers: change '# Feature: FEAT-001' marker if it includes the human-readable name. (6) Update Gherkin feature file headers with the new name. (7) Run living-doc-gap-finder to confirm no orphan references remain.
expectations: Lists all 7 cascade steps
Step 2: update feature_id in Functionality entities
Step 3: update feature_registry.json
Step 5: update PageObject file headers
Step 6: update Gherkin # Feature: headers
Step 7: run gap-finder to confirm clean state
